# Numerical Integrity & Requirements Quality Checklist: `greedyExtremeRayBasis`

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the English of `spec.md`. Every item asks whether a
requirement is stated completely, unambiguously, measurably and without prejudging the
remedy. No item asserts a numerical result or inspects code; each is answerable by
reading `spec.md` alone.

**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## 1. Unjustified Constants

- [x] CHK001 Does the spec forbid an accuracy target chosen for convenience, and require its derivation to be recorded? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK002 Is the accuracy target tied to a stated *reason* — the separation a rank determination needs between retained and discarded singular values — rather than to a bare number? [Measurability, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK003 Does the spec state that an agent-chosen regime boundary is a defect against the requirement, not an acceptable default? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK004 Does the spec enumerate admissible groundings for the boundary (machine precision relative to the norm, attainable residual floor, condition estimate) without mandating one? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK005 Is the boundary's derivation required to be independently re-checkable by a reviewer without re-running the implementation? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008]
- [x] CHK006 Does the spec avoid stating any numeric tolerance of its own that would pre-empt the measurement? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, §FR-006]
- [x] CHK007 Is it specified *which matrix* the regime classification is applied to: `model.S` as supplied, or the internally reduced/transposed matrix actually used (after consistency restriction, and after transposition in right-nullspace mode)? [Gap, Spec §FR-005]
  **RESOLVED 2026-09-14** — Resolved by revision: FR-005 now requires classification of the matrix actually operated on (post-restriction, post-transposition) and requires the status to say which matrix was classified.


## 2. Prejudging The Remedy

- [x] CHK008 Does the spec state the required *outcome* of ray acceptance rather than mandating a mechanism for achieving it? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK009 Are all four candidate remedies listed as candidates requiring measurement, with none adopted? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK010 Is non-negativity stated as a hard constraint that excludes remedies violating it, with ordinary orthogonalisation named as excluded? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK011 Does the spec identify the entry-magnitude ratio as a symptom and the absolute acceptance tolerance as the operative cause, so the remedy is not aimed at the wrong target? [Clarity, Spec §Problem Statement]
- [x] CHK012 Is verification required *on the returned object* rather than inferred from the acceptance path, so the requirement survives any choice of remedy? [Measurability, Spec §FR-003]

## 3. Over-Promising

- [x] CHK013 Does the spec explicitly decline to promise any attainable residual? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK014 Does the spec explicitly decline to promise a runtime? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK015 Does the spec explicitly decline to predict which regime any named model falls into, `iDopaNeuroC` included? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions, §SC-005]
- [x] CHK016 Is the case where the attainable residual is floored *above* the derived target treated as a legitimate reportable finding rather than a failure to be worked around? [Coverage, Spec §Assumptions, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK017 Is "reasonably well scaled" explicitly denied any prior meaning beyond the measured boundary? [Ambiguity, Spec §Assumptions]

## 4. Silent-Wrongness Coverage

- [x] CHK018 Is there a requirement covering soft basis rows — rows admitted at an accuracy too loose for downstream rank determination? [Coverage, Spec §FR-001, §FR-003]
- [x] CHK019 Is there a requirement covering zero-padded incomplete bases, including that the row count must equal rays actually accepted? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK020 Is there a requirement preventing a caller from receiving a well-formed but unreliable second output in Regime B? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK021 Is the status required to be complete when console output is suppressed, so a caller that never reads warnings is still informed? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008, §FR-017]
- [x] CHK022 Are all terminal outcomes required to be distinguishable from the status alone? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK023 Is there a requirement covering the undefined-field crash path on a default-parameter call? [Coverage, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK024 Does the spec say what actually *happens* to a row that cannot meet the accuracy target? FR-003 forbids returning it "silently" but names no outcome: dropped from the basis, whole call downgraded to a diagnosis, or recorded in the status. FR-009's list of terminal outcomes has no entry for "some rows failed the target". [Gap, Spec §FR-003, §FR-009]
  **RESOLVED 2026-09-14** — Resolved by revision: FR-003a specifies drop-and-continue, requires the accuracy-rejection count in the status, and requires a run that rejected every candidate to be distinguishable from one that ran out of time.

- [x] CHK025 Is the behaviour specified for right-nullspace mode? Every requirement is written for the *left* nullspace, but the function supports a right-nullspace option; the spec never says whether both regimes, the accuracy target and the status apply there, or whether that mode is out of scope. [Gap, Spec §FR-001, §Out of Scope]
  **RESOLVED 2026-09-14** — Resolved by revision: FR-020 makes every requirement mode-agnostic and forbids leaving one mode on the pre-change acceptance behaviour.

- [x] CHK026 Is the delivery mechanism for the FR-013 diagnosis specified? FR-008 requires a graceful return for Regime B, but FR-013 says only "actionable diagnosis" without stating whether that is a status outcome or a raised error. [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-013]
  **RESOLVED 2026-09-14** — Resolved by revision: FR-013 now specifies a graceful return carrying the FR-009 status outcome, consistent with FR-008's return-don't-raise rule.


## 5. Breaking-Change Discipline

- [x] CHK027 Does the spec record an *explicit approval* of the breaking change, traceable to a dated decision? [Traceability, Spec §FR-015a, §Clarifications]
- [x] CHK028 Does the spec document a *migration path*, as Principle II requires of any approved break? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015b]
- [x] CHK029 Is the migration statement required to appear where a caller will actually meet it, rather than only in the feature directory? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015b, §SC-012]
- [x] CHK030 Is call-syntax compatibility separated from results compatibility, so the third output cannot be mistaken for the breaking part? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015, §FR-015a]
- [x] CHK031 Is it stated that a caller passing a previously-accepted parameter must not begin to error? [Coverage, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK032 Is the residual role of the existing tolerance parameter specified? FR-015a forbids *loosening* acceptance below the derived target but is silent on whether a caller may still *tighten* it, and on whether the parameter remains accepted, is deprecated, or is removed. A caller reading the spec cannot tell what the parameter now does. [Gap, Spec §FR-015a]
  **RESOLVED 2026-09-14** — Resolved by revision: FR-015a retains the parameter but clamps it — accepted without error, may tighten, may never loosen above the derived target.


## 6. Measurability & Traceability

- [x] CHK033 Is the headline success criterion stated as agreement between independent instruments, so it is checkable without knowing the remedy? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK034 Is the tolerance span over which rank agreement must hold quantified rather than left as "a range"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, §SC-002]
- [x] CHK035 Are both absolute and scaled residual reporting required, with the scaling factor named? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016, §SC-009]
- [x] CHK036 Are implied nullity, independent rank, non-negativity, runtime and replicate count all required in the report? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016, §SC-009]
- [x] CHK037 Does every traceability row name both a discharging test and the source function, with no orphan rows? [Traceability, Spec §Traceability]
- [x] CHK038 Do SC-003 and SC-005 appear in the traceability table? Both are stated success criteria but neither is mapped to a discharging test, so the table is incomplete against its own "every acceptance criterion appears exactly once" rule. [Gap, Spec §Traceability]
  **RESOLVED 2026-09-14** — Resolved by revision: SC-003 and SC-005 now have traceability rows, alongside new rows for FR-003a, FR-020, FR-013 and FR-016a.

- [x] CHK039 Is FR-016 internally consistent about *who* reports? It requires "the routine" to report runtime and replicate count, but a single invocation cannot know a replicate count; that obligation belongs to the feature's measurement record, not the function. The requirement conflates two different reporters. [Conflict, Spec §FR-016]
  **RESOLVED 2026-09-14** — Resolved by revision: FR-016 now covers only what a single call can know; FR-016a assigns replicate counts to the feature's measurement record.

- [x] CHK040 Is the "number expected" that FR-010 requires in the status reconciled with the Edge Cases warning that this count comes from a rank computation which cannot be treated as ground truth? [Conflict, Spec §FR-010, §Edge Cases]
  **RESOLVED 2026-09-14** — Resolved by revision: FR-010 requires the status to label the expected count as derived from a rank computation — a target, not ground truth.


## 7. Scope Boundedness

- [x] CHK041 Is the prohibition on editing the downstream `varkin` guards stated unambiguously as a MUST NOT? [Clarity, Spec §Out of Scope]
- [x] CHK042 Is `plan.md` required to record what `varkin` would need to assert, so the follow-on work can be specified separately? [Completeness, Spec §Out of Scope]
- [x] CHK043 Are the rank routines explicitly excluded from change, and their known over-estimation framed as evidence rather than as a defect in scope? [Consistency, Spec §Out of Scope]
- [x] CHK044 Is forming the augmented matrix excluded, with this feature accountable only for the basis's fitness for that use? [Clarity, Spec §Out of Scope, §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK045 Is repairing model scaling excluded, leaving this feature to diagnose and recommend only? [Clarity, Spec §Out of Scope]
- [x] CHK046 Is the availability of the `iDopaNeuroC` regression case established? SC-005 makes it a success criterion, but the measured evidence came from frozen instances in the `varkin` repository, and the spec never states whether that model is reachable from this repository or from CI. A success criterion that cannot be exercised here is not yet a requirement. [Dependency, Gap, Spec §SC-005]
  **RESOLVED 2026-09-14** — Resolved by investigation and revision: the model is present at papers/2023_iDopaNeuro/models/iDopaNeuroC.mat, but papers/ is a git submodule, so SC-005 is re-specified as a documented reproducibility check under Principle III, with SC-011 requiring the CI test to depend on no submodule content.
